item.title: Ask HN: How to plan for a future when the advice is always to focus on the now?
item.summary: Qui-Gon: "Don't center on your anxieties, Obi-Wan. Keep your concentration here and now, where it belongs." Obi-Wan: "But Master Yoda said I should be mindful of the future." Qui-Gon: "But not at the expense of the moment. Be mindful of the living Force, young Padawan." Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49408925 Points: 2 # Comments: 1
